QUOTE: "`_DEFINITIVE`: "This IS a definitive empty result… Do not retry" ... `_UNREAD_CORPUS`: "NOT DEFINITIVE… this index HOLDS matching rows that search does not read" ... `_PROSE_ELSEWHERE`: "NOT DEFINITIVE… this repository DOES use these terms""
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer separates definitive from not-definitive, but it never names a "definitive for a reason that is not absence" grade. Its only definitive grade means nothing was found in scope, so the three-way distinction is missing.
